references.text: 4. Moses also describes the laws concerning cities of refuge for someone who kills another by accident, without hostility or evil intent, paralleling the example of chopping wood in the forest.
2. Moses mentions that God will designate a place where someone who kills another without planning it can flee to – this is the basis for the city of refuge system.
Joshua carries out the Lord's command to establish cities of refuge, where someone who accidentally kills another may seek protection from the avenger of blood.
Moses designated three cities of refuge east of the Jordan for those who kill someone by accident, as a practical application of the law described in this verse.
Detailed instructions on the function of the cities of refuge to protect someone who unintentionally causes another's death.
